Players Committee card image of [[Captain Bewil (V)]] (original printing), game text: “While at a Cloud City site, adds one to the number of Bespin locations required to cancel Dark Deal. Once per turn, if Dark Deal on table, may search your Force Pile and take one Interrupt into hand; reshuffle.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/captainbewil.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
